prompt: Create a beautiful production game sprite of a complete medieval STONE FORTRESS, on a genuinely transparent background. Art direction: authentic restrained medieval illuminated manuscript / hand-painted marginal illustration, earthy and dignified, irregular dark umber pen contours, matte muted gouache washes, very subtle paper pigment inside shapes only. NOT cute toy castle, NOT Disney fantasy, NOT glossy vector art, NOT 3D or realistic rendering. Composition: one substantial squat rectangular stone keep with a crenellated flat top, two lower round defensive towers WITHOUT conical roofs, one low connected perimeter curtain wall enclosing a small readable courtyard and a SINGLE low muted terracotta-roofed hall. Three-quarter elevated view with simple believable architectural connections. Entrance on the unseen rear side; NO large gate or doorway on the visible outside. Clear asymmetrical silhouette: central keep is the dominant mass, low walls are supporting masses. Only TWO small dark muted vermilion pennants and ONE narrow vermilion fabric banner, no emblems or text; avoid forest of flags, spires and red roofs. Large warm grey limestone blocks, restrained ochre highlights, muted earthy brown details, sparse confident masonry lines, no speckle noise, no ivy. Calm medieval historical feeling rather than a bright plastic model. Whole fortress fully visible, clean alpha silhouette, no floor slab, terrain, scenery, horizon, halo or cast shadow. Designed for 170x240 pixel gameplay rendering, with broad readable forms and good negative space between masses. Portrait 3:4, safely padded. Reference image is only a guide for hand-ink contour and matte pigment treatment; do not include people.
decision: 完整堡壘：主堡、內院、多層城牆；不以城門為主體。紅藍共用一張素材。
